title: Zoom, the little red car.
lines: In a big city, with tall buildings and busy streets, lives a little car.
Zoom is red, bright red, and he has two big headlights that look like friendly eyes.
Every morning he starts his engine.
Today Zoom may drive to the seaside to visit Grandma Bus.
First Zoom drives through the city.
Big cars, small cars, a yellow taxi and a blue police car.
Everyone has to be very careful.
Zoom knows: at red you must stop.
A mummy with a pram crosses at the zebra crossing.
At the edge of the city Zoom drives along a country road.
Yesterday it rained a lot, and the road is full of puddles.
And another one, a really big one!
Now Zoom is all dirty, covered in brown mud.
You can hardly see his red colour anymore.
I can't arrive at Grandma's like this, says Zoom.
Luckily there is a car wash by the road.
Then comes soap, with lots and lots of bubbles.
Bubbles on his roof, bubbles on his wheels, bubbles everywhere.
Hee hee, that tickles, laughs Zoom.
Then big soft brushes spin around.
And at the end warm wind blows.
There was a sharp nail on the road, and it went into his wheel.
He stands at the side of the road and he is a bit sad.
How will I get to Grandma's now?
Luckily there is a garage a little further along.
He is wearing blue overalls and holding a big spanner.
What's wrong with you, little car?
My tyre is flat, says Zoom.
He lifts Zoom up with a jack.
He patches up the little hole.
And then he pumps the tyre full of air again.
Zoom drives on, along the long motorway, through a dark tunnel where he turns on his lights, and over a high bridge.
And then he sees it in the distance: the sea!
And there, in the car park by the beach, is Grandma Bus.
A big yellow bus with lots and lots of windows.
How nice and red and clean you are!
Zoom tells her everything: about the red light, the mud, the bubbles in the car wash and his flat tyre.
And that evening Zoom and Grandma Bus watch the sun together as it sinks into the sea like a big orange ball.
